title: Red-first SysTest for a report data provider
instruction: In the sandbox model, test a report data provider the way the server supports it. (1) Scaffold an SSRS report named DemoDpTest over ConDemoNoteHeader with generate_object(mode="scaffold", objectType="report", fieldsHint="NoteId, Subject", generateController=false), and give its DP a processReport() that stages one row per ConDemoNoteHeader record. (2) Ask prepare(mode="test", objectName="<the DP class>") which shape the target needs — it resolves a data provider from what it extends and answers "report-dp". (3) Scaffold the test with generate_object(mode="pattern", pattern="systest", testTargetType="report-dp", baseName="<the Contract class>", datasetAccessor="<the [SRSReportDataSetAttribute] getter>"). The accessor is a PARAMETER and must be read off the DP — SrsReportDataProviderBase has eleven members and none is a getTmp*, and the platform itself ships a mis-typed one. (4) Write the class, build (it must COMPILE — red means a failing assertion, not a broken file), and run it with run_systest_class: the first run must FAIL, because every scaffolded method ends in this.fail(...). (5) Replace the failing bodies with real assertions on the staged rows, build, and run again — green. Do not test through the controller: a report's X++ half ends at the staged rows, and whether the RDL binds them is Report Designer work.
